note: Starter foods, added gradually. One object per line. Only `slug`, `en` and `group` are required — everything else is filled in when it is known. Conventions: nutrients are per 100 g/ml and use the EU labelling basis, so `carbsG` EXCLUDES fibre (USDA-style tables include it — subtract `fiberG` first). Set `state` to raw/cooked/dry on anything where that changes the numbers, especially grains and pulses. `seasonMonths` are 1-12 and local to where you live. `glycemicIndex` describes the food as actually eaten; glycemic load is derived, never stored. `diversityKey` makes varieties of the same plant count once toward the weekly target.
